error_list.original_text: 依托物联网、5G、大数据三大技术实现园区精细化管理
error_list.translated_text: relying on the Internet of Things and big data to realize refined park management
error_list.error_explanation: 原文包含三大技术：物联网、5G、大数据，译文遗漏关键技术“5G”，信息缺失

error_list.original_text: 截至2025年上半年，国内已建成智慧园区项目共计2760个
error_list.translated_text: By the first half of 2024, a total of 2160 smart park projects have been built in China
error_list.error_explanation: 原文时间2025上半年、数量2760个；译文错写为2024上半年、2160个，两处数字同时出错

error_list.original_text: 智慧园区主要服务企业办公、安防监控、能耗管控、访客管理四大业务场景
error_list.translated_text: Smart parks mainly serve four business scenarios: enterprise office, security monitoring and energy consumption control
error_list.error_explanation: 四大业务场景，译文遗漏“访客管理”，场景信息缺失

error_list.original_text: 安防模块支持视频AI识别、异常告警、人员轨迹回溯
error_list.translated_text: The security module supports video AI recognition and abnormal alarms
error_list.error_explanation: 译文遗漏安防能力“人员轨迹回溯”，丢失功能描述

error_list.original_text: 能够及时识别翻越围墙、明火等安全风险
error_list.translated_text: which can timely identify safety risks such as open fire
error_list.error_explanation: 译文漏掉风险类型“翻越围墙”，安全风险描述不全

error_list.original_text: 帮助园区降低18%左右的综合能耗
error_list.translated_text: helping parks reduce comprehensive energy consumption by about 35%
error_list.error_explanation: 原文节能18%，译文错误改写为35%，关键指标数字错误

error_list.original_text: 硬件设备品牌繁多，不同厂商设备协议不兼容，造成数据孤岛现象
error_list.translated_text: Hardware equipment comes from few brands, and equipment protocols from different manufacturers are compatible, eliminating data silos
error_list.error_explanation: 原文品牌多、协议不兼容、产生数据孤岛；译文全部反向：品牌少、协议兼容、消除数据孤岛，语义完全颠倒

error_list.original_text: 部分中小园区预算有限，难以承担全套智能化改造费用
error_list.translated_text: Some small and medium‑sized parks have sufficient budget and can afford full‑set intelligent renovation costs
error_list.error_explanation: 原文预算有限承担不起，译文翻译成预算充足可以承担，语义相反

error_list.original_text: 同时运维人才缺口较大，设备故障不能得到及时处理
error_list.translated_text: Meanwhile, operation‑maintenance talents are abundant, and equipment faults can be dealt with immediately
error_list.error_explanation: 原文人才缺口大、故障难及时处理；译文译为人才充足、故障立刻处理，逻辑倒置

error_list.original_text: 未来智慧园区将朝着软硬一体化方向演进
error_list.translated_text: In the future, smart parks will evolve toward software‑only development
error_list.error_explanation: 原文“软硬一体化”错译为仅软件(software‑only)，核心发展方向术语翻译错误
